elements_of_practical_and_physical_geogr.map_work: Map reading and interpretation based on contoured survey maps of parts of West Africa: scale, measurement of distances, direction and bearing, map reduction and enlargement, identification of physical features such as spurs, valleys, etc. and cultural features such as city walls, settlements, communication routes, etc.; measurement of gradients, drawing of cross profiles, inter-visibility, description and explanation of drainage characteristics and pattern; patterns of communication, settlement and land use.
elements_of_practical_and_physical_geogr.principles_of_elementary_surveying: Definitions of terms, instruments, chain and prismatic compass, plotting of traverse, avoiding obstacles in the field.
elements_of_practical_and_physical_geogr.geographic_information_system_gis: GIS: Basic concepts, components (hardware, software, data, procedures and experts); sources of data (land surveying, remote sensing, map digitizing, map scanning, field investigation and tabular data etc); uses (defence, agriculture, urban development, mapping, surveying, transportation, census etc), problems (power, personnel, capital etc).
elements_of_practical_and_physical_geogr.statistical_maps_and_diagrams: Graphical representation of statistical data: Bar graphs, Line graphs, flow charts, dot maps, proportional circles, density maps, isopleth maps.

elements_of_physical_geography.the_earth_as_a_planet: The earth as a planet in relation to the sun, latitude and distance, longitude and time, earth’s rotation and revolution and their effects, structure of the earth (internal and external).
elements_of_physical_geography.hydrosphere: Ocean basins, salinity, ocean current (causes, types and their effects on the temperature of adjacent coastlands), lakes, rivers, lagoons, water as an environmental resource.
elements_of_physical_geography.tectonic_processes: Vulcanicity, earthquake, landforms: Mountains, plains, karsts and coastal landforms (formation, characteristics and importance).
elements_of_physical_geography.denudational_processes: Agencies modifying landforms such as weathering, mass movement, running water, underground water, wind and waves.

weather_and_climate.simple_weather_study: Simple weather study based on local observation, description of the Stevenson’s screen and uses of basic weather instruments e.g. rain gauge, thermometer, barometer, wind vane etc.
weather_and_climate.elements: Rainfall, sunshine, air pressure, wind, humidity, temperature and cloud. Factors affecting climatic elements e.g. altitude, latitude, ocean currents, land and sea breezes, continentality, aspect. Interpretation of climatic charts and data.
weather_and_climate.classification: Major types of climate (Hot climate – Equatorial, Tropical Continental, Desert; Temperate climate – warm and cool). Classification of climate based on Greek and Koppen.

elements_of_physical_geography.vegetation: Major types (Tropical Rainforest, cool/warm temperate woodland, Tropical Grassland); characteristics, distribution, factors affecting their distribution, plant communities. Vegetation as an environmental resource. Conservation of vegetation resources.
elements_of_physical_geography.soil: Definition, local types and characteristics. Factors and processes of soil formation, soil profile, importance to man and the effects of human activities on soil. Soil erosion and conservation.

the_environment.environmental_resources: Meaning, classification (renewable and non renewable) types (vegetation, water, mineral, atmospheric, etc) and the importance of each.
the_environment.environmental_problems_hazards: Types (soil erosion, drought, desert encroachment, flooding and pollution), causes, effects and prevention of each.
the_environment.environmental_conservation: Meaning, importance, methods, problems and solutions.

economic_and_human_geography.world_population: Factors and patterns of growth, distribution and movement, growth rate problems.
economic_and_human_geography.settlement: Types (rural and urban); patterns and factors affecting location; growth and size; functions of rural and urban settlements; interaction patterns (urban-rural, rural-urban, urban-urban, rural-rural); migration.
economic_and_human_geography.transportation: Modes (roads, railways, water, air, pipeline, cables, ropeways etc.) Transportation and economic development (movement of people and commodities, national and international trade, diffusion of ideas and technology, national integration); problems of transportation and their solutions.
economic_and_human_geography.industry: Classification (primary, secondary and tertiary); types (heavy and light industry); factors of industrial location; contributions to development; problems/solutions.
economic_and_human_geography.trade: Meaning, types (national and international), reasons for trade, importance.
economic_and_human_geography.tourism: Meaning, centres, reasons (leisure, recreation, education etc); importance, problems and solutions.

nigeria.broad_outline: Location, position, size, distance and political divisions.
nigeria.population: Size, distribution, structure, population quality, population movement, population data (sources and problems/solutions).

resources.mineral: Mineral (petroleum, gas, coal, tin/columbite, iron ore, limestone)- distribution, methods of extraction, problems and solutions.
resources.power: Power (Petroleum, gas, coal HEP, solar energy).
resources.water: Water (rivers, lakes, dams, sea, underground water).
resources.vegetation: Vegetation (trees, food and cash crops; timber,etc)- forest, savanna, biosphere.

nigeria.agriculture: Types of agricultural practices, food and cash crops, importance, problems and solutions.
nigeria.transportation: Mode, advantages and disadvantages, problems and solutions, influence of transportation on human activities.
nigeria.communication: Communication networks, advantages and disadvantages, importance, problems and solutions.
nigeria.industry: Definition, types, major industrial zones, factors of location, importance, problems and solutions.
nigeria.trade: Meaning, types (national and international), stock exchange, capital market, forex, major commercial areas, importance of commercial activities.
nigeria.tourism: Meaning, centres, reasons for tourism, importance, problems and solutions.
nigeria.issues_on_development_and_environmental_: Issues of Development and Environmental Conservation: Rural and regional development, resource management and conservation, environmental pollution e.g. air, water, soil, noise; waste disposal, etc.
nigeria.ecowas: Meaning, member countries, purposes/mandate, advantages/benefits, disadvantages, problems and solutions.

ghana.physical_setting: Physical environment (geology, relief, drainage, climate, vegetation and soils).
ghana.population: Size, growth, distribution and density, age/sex structure: fertility, morbidity and mortality, migration.
ghana.settlement: Origin, types (rural and urban), characteristics, hierarchy, land use, urbanization processes, problems and solutions.

primary_economic_activities.agriculture: Subsistence (intensive and extensive) commercial (vegetable, livestock, dairying, commercial grain), plantation, problems and solutions.
primary_economic_activities.fishing: Inland and ocean (in-shore/off shore), methods, types of fish, storage and marketing, importance, problems and solutions.
primary_economic_activities.lumbering: Sources of timber, methods of exploitation, types of species (for internal use and for export), problems and solutions, conservation.
primary_economic_activities.mining: Types, distribution of minerals, methods of extraction, importance, problems and solutions.

ghana.manufacturing: Types of manufacturing industries, distribution, factors influencing location of industries, problems of industrialization.
ghana.trade_and_commerce: Services, transport and communication, recreation and tourism, administration. Meaning, types (national and international), stock exchange, capital market, forex, major commercial areas, importance of commercial activities.
ghana.tourism: Meaning, centres, reasons for tourism, importance, problems and solutions.
ghana.energy_and_power: Water (Akosombo and Kpong Hydro-electric Power projects – benefits and side effects), fuel wood and charcoal, petroleum and natural gas (Saltpond), solar, wave and wind energies (Donkokrom and Kokrobite), Biogas e.g. cow dung.
ghana.issues_on_development_and_environmental_: Issues of Development and Environmental Conservation: Rural and regional development, resource management and conservation, environmental pollution e.g. air, water, soil, noise; waste disposal etc.

primary_economic_activities.fishing: Meaning of fishing, Inland and ocean (in-shore/off shore), methods, types of fish, storage and marketing, importance, problems and solutions.
primary_economic_activities.lumbering: Meaning of lumbering, Sources of timber, methods of exploitation, types of species (for internal use and for export), problems and solutions, conservation.
primary_economic_activities.mining: Types, distribution of minerals, methods of extraction, importance, problems and solutions.

sierra_leone.manufacturing: Types of manufacturing industries, distribution, factors influencing location of industries, problems of industrialization.

sierra_leone.tourism: Meaning, development of tourism, problems of tourism & solutions, socio-economic effects of tourism. Main tourism areas, factors responsible for its development, economic importance.

detailed_syllabus.field_work: Fieldwork on any one of the following topics should be based on local geography of candidate’s home country: (i) Land use (rural or urban): rural – crop farming (e.g. rice, cocoa, etc.), urban crop farming, mining (e.g. coal, tin, petroleum etc.), fishing. urban – commercial activities, ports, factories, recreational etc. (ii) Market survey – rural or urban. (iii) Traffic flow – rural or urban. (iv) Patterns of journey to work – rural or urban. (v) Rate of erosion in the locality, etc.
